results.title: Flood Fury Across India: Heavy Rain, Landslides and Rising Rivers Disrupt Life
results.description: Heavy rain and flooding have disrupted normal life across several parts of India, with conditions worsening from the hills to the plains. In Himachal Pradesh’s Mandi, a landslide sent rocks and debris onto a road, forcing traffic to stop, while a large boulder reportedly struck a moving car in Kangra. In Dehradun, the swollen Tamsa River flooded the Tapkeshwar Mahadev Temple परिसर. Jammu and Kashmir also witnessed rising water levels, with three dam gates opened in Ramban. In Uttar Pradesh, the Ganga rose rapidly in Farrukhabad, washing away a house amid severe erosion, while floodwaters entered residential areas in Varanasi. In Prayagraj, rising Ganga and Yamuna levels reached the walls of the Bade Hanuman temple. Patna also saw floodwater approaching roads. Meanwhile, heavy rain in Punjab’s Mohali area caused a strong water surge that swept away a pickup carrying buffaloes. Authorities have urged residents to remain alert.
